forks.assumption: both raters measure the same underlying skin-tone construct on a comparable scale

forks.assumption: the chosen coding of card counts captures the disciplinary signal of interest

forks.assumption: missing skin-tone is unrelated to red-card propensity

forks.assumption: baseline group differences are informative despite no adjustment
